items.text: Going from Lamar Jackson to Tyler Huntley is a downgrade... but for our purposes it doesn't really matter. Lamar officially OUT (ankle).
items.why: Ankle sprain; DNP all week. Huntley starts vs ATL.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade; limits upside for Flowers/Andrews in run-heavier script possible.
items.opportunity: Huntley game-manager; check RZ/two-min for Likely/Henry if volume shifts.

items.text: With Ashton Jeanty questionable because of foot and ankle injuries, the Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.why: Foot/ankle; missed Friday practice after limited Thu. Coach: will do best to play.
items.implication: GTD; if OUT, Mike Washington lead back (RB2/flex value). Monitor 90-min window.
items.opportunity: If inactive, full backfield to Washington/Hemby; reverse if unexpectedly ACTIVE.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Houston remains primary suitor; no deal complete until after Sunday games. Tenure in AZ over.
items.why: Trade imminent; team comfortable with offer (sought 1st-round value).
items.implication: Zero fantasy production Week 5; long-term destination TBD (HOU/Stroud reunion possible).
items.opportunity: Full target/route share opens for remaining ARI WRs, especially Michael Wilson.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) ruled OUT for Week 5 Eagles at Jaguars (London). Week-to-week; not on IR. Tank Bigsby already IR (core).
items.why: Hamstring injury from prior week; DNP practice.
items.opportunity: Will Shipley primary back; Dameon Pierce elevated for depth. Snap/carry share to committee.

items.text: Commanders: Jayden Daniels back/starting (elbow brace, full go no restrictions). Elevated Van Jefferson; McNichols OUT (quad). Diggs OUT hamstring.
items.why: Elbow recovery complete per coach/OC; Mariota also banged up.
items.implication: QB upgrade for WAS offense vs NYG; McLaurin Q but optimistic.
items.opportunity: Full dual-threat usage returns; Diggs absence boosts McLaurin/others.

items.text: The cruelest thing to happen to anyone that drafted Marvin Harrison Jr this year is him not being active to face the Lions secondary.
items.why: Missed elite matchup vs DET secondary due to trade inactive.
items.implication: Sit/drop consideration short-term; monitor trade landing spot.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games. He wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. It is Kia Kendrick Bourne szn post-inactive/trade.
items.why: MHJ production minimal; Wilson already operating independently.
items.implication: Wilson immediate WR upgrade/start vs DET with MHJ out; Bourne also elevated.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets expand further in ARI offense sans MHJ.

items.text: Sunday schedule for NFL In-Season: Wake and Rake 10am, FanDuel Examination 1035am, Last-Minute Livestream 1145am. Top Plays Week 5 live. Monitor injuries/inactives aggressively in windows.
items.why: Standard Sunday Mode coverage for status changes 90-min pre-kick, warmups.
items.implication: Real-time updates on Qs like Jeanty/Chase/Flowers/McConkey/Jefferson.

items.text: Dallas Goedert returns ACTIVE after missing two weeks (knee). Full participant; top target for Hurts especially RZ with Smith/Wicks limited/out.
items.why: Knee recovery; practiced limited then full. Smith OUT hamstring.
items.implication: TE1 upside; 8-10+ targets possible in London game.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets/RZ share with key WRs sidelined.

items.text: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) OUT Week 5 along with Barkley and Hollywood Brown. Goedert returns into elevated role.
Stefon Diggs (hamstring) OUT for Commanders. McLaurin Q/optimistic with Daniels returning.
items.implication: McLaurin primary WR if active; short-area to TEs/others.
items.opportunity: McLaurin target share up; monitor her status closely.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) OUT again Week 5 vs CLE. Week-to-week, not IR. Braelon Allen handled nearly all snaps prior.
items.implication: Allen locked RB2/flex with high snap share.
items.opportunity: Allen 30+ snap monopoly continues; minimal committee.

items.text: Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10 love. Volume including red zone; defenses struggle vs WRs. Now amplified by MHJ inactive.
items.why: Target volume + matchup; MHJ out seals upgrade.

items.text: Multiple moves: Pittman IR (foot re-aggravation); Packers Brooks IR; Jets Tim Patrick activated (no designation); Pats Hollins/Gilliam IR; Chargers Lance/Penning IR, Matlock/Taylor activate; Seahawks Trevon Diggs (CB) signed; OBJ elevated MIN; Rams Donald/Parkinson expected play MNF.
items.why: Foot re-injury for Pittman; various activations/IRs.
items.implication: Pittman out min 4 games; Roman Wilson No. 2 WR PIT. Patrick depth NYJ.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes up in PIT; monitor other elevations for snaps.

items.text: Chase Brown (The Brown Gobbler) loved a lot this week as RB5. Gobbles targets + points; usage/matchup vs MIA. Bengals WR injuries help.
items.why: High target share + soft matchup; potential Chase/Higgins absence boosts checkdowns.

items.text: Love, love, LOVE Nico Collins against the Titans this week. I have Nico as my WR8. Volume/red-zone + matchup.
items.why: Target hog + RZ usage vs soft TEN defense.

items.text: Loves Christian Watson WR15 vs CHI and Isaiah Likely TE5 (with Lamar out context). Matchup/coverage weaknesses.
items.why: Positional/matchup edges; Likely gains with Huntley/Lamar absence.
items.opportunity: Watson deep threat; Likely TE volume/RZ.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (WR41, injury/tough matchup), Mark Andrews (TE17, Lamar out limits), Cam Skattebo (RB20 efficiency/game script), Tony Pollard (RB28), Jalen Hurts (QB15 rough stretch/banged line vs JAX).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency concerns, Lamar absence for Andrews, Hurts line/script issues.
items.implication: Fade/sit in most formats this week.
items.opportunity: Limited projected snaps/targets/carries relative to price/rank.
